name: TabletForum
css: .tablet-forum-page{min-height:100vh;background:#f5f7fa;font-family:'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.top-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:64px;padding:0 24px;background:#ffffff;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f2f5;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100}.nav-left{display:flex;align-items:center}.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.logo-text{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#1A365D}.nav-center{flex:1;display:flex;justify-content:center}.page-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:#1A365D;margin:0}.nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}.create-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1A365D 0%,#2a5298 100%);color:#ffffff;border:none;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}.create-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(26,54,95,0.3)}.nav-icon{cursor:pointer}.user-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1A365D 0%,#2a5298 100%);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer}.main-content{flex:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px 1fr 280px;gap:20px;padding:20px;overflow:hidden}.left-panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;overflow-y:auto}.category-card,.tags-card{background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04)}.card-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}.card-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#1a2b5f;margin:0}.category-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}.category-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;color:#5a6488}.category-item:hover{background:#f8f9fc;color:#1A365D}.category-item.active{background:#1A365D;color:#ffffff}.category-name{flex:1;font-size:14px;font-weight:500}.category-count{font-size:12px;color:#8899aa}.tags-list{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.tag-item{padding:6px 12px;background:#f5f7fa;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;color:#5a6488;cursor:pointer}.tag-item:hover{background:#1A365D;color:#ffffff}.center-content{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;overflow-y:auto}.filter-bar{background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 16px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04)}.filter-tabs{display:flex;gap:12px}.filter-tab{padding:6px 16px;border-radius:6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:#5a6488;cursor:pointer}.filter-tab.active{background:#1A365D;color:#ffffff}.post-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}.post-card{background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:20px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04);cursor:pointer}.post-card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(26,54,95,0.1);transform:translateY(-2px)}.post-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}.author-info{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.author-avatar{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.author-detail{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.author-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#1a2b5f}.post-time{font-size:12px;color:#8899aa}.post-tag{padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600}.post-content{margin-bottom:12px}.post-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:#1a2b5f;margin:0 0 8px}.post-excerpt{font-size:14px;color:#5a6488;line-height:1.5;margin:0;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}.post-footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #f0f2f5}.post-stats{display:flex;gap:16px}.stat-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:13px;color:#8899aa}.post-tags{display:flex;gap:8px}.post-tag-item{padding:4px 10px;background:#f5f7fa;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;color:#5a6488}.pagination{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 16px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04)}.page-info{font-size:13px;color:#8899aa}.page-buttons{display:flex;gap:8px}.page-btn{padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid #e8ecf1;border-radius:6px;background:#ffffff;font-size:13px;color:#5a6488;cursor:pointer}.page-btn.active{background:#1A365D;border-color:#1A365D;color:#ffffff}.right-panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;overflow-y:auto}.hot-card,.active-card{background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04)}.hot-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.hot-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px;background:#f8f9fc;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}.hot-item:hover{background:#f0f2f5}.hot-rank{width:24px;height:24px;background:#e8ecf1;border-radius:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#5a6488}.hot-rank.top{background:#c41e3a;color:#ffffff}.hot-info{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.hot-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:#1a2b5f;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.hot-views{font-size:12px;color:#8899aa}.active-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.active-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px;border-radius:8px}.active-avatar{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.active-info{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.active-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:#1a2b5f}.active-posts{font-size:12px;color:#8899aa}.bottom-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:40px;padding:0 24px;background:#ffffff;border-top:1px solid #f0f2f5}.bar-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}.online-status,.sync-status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:#5a6488}.version{font-size:12px;color:#8899aa}@media(max-width:1024px){.main-content{grid-template-columns:1fr}.left-panel,.right-panel{display:none}}
